name_ja: 塩漬けタケノコの天ぷら
name_en: Shiozuke Takenoko no Tenpura — tempura of salt-cured bamboo shoot
summary_ja: 塩抜きした大多喜産のタケノコを醤油だれで下味をつけ、卵と小麦粉の衣で揚げる一品。あくが少なく白いのが特徴の「白たけのこ」を塩漬けで保存し、旬を過ぎても年間を通して味わえるようにした知恵と伝わる。
summary_en: Bamboo shoots from Otaki, known for a pale color and little bitterness, are salt-cured then desalted, seasoned in a soy sauce mixture, and fried in an egg-and-flour batter — a way, it's said, of holding onto shoots grown in a short spring season long enough to eat them year-round.
source_title: 塩漬けタケノコの天ぷら 千葉県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
